lead_capture.trigger_conditions_cn:
当用户表达以下任一类意图时，应将 purchase_intent 判为 "yes"：
1）询价与价格：多少钱、报价、价格表、费用、预算、折扣、付款方式等；
2）购买与渠道：哪里买、如何下单、订购、预订、现货/交期、发货、经销、代理、区域销售、官方购买链接等；
3）商务与合作：采购、招标、批量、企业合作、渠道合作、成为合作伙伴、销售对接、商务微信/电话等；
4）试用与演示：预约演示、上门演示、试用、样机、PoC、参观展厅等。

以下情况一般判为 "no"（除非同时出现上述购买/商务诉求）：纯产品功能/参数/使用方法/充电与维护/故障排查/质保政策等技术咨询；与竞品泛泛对比但无购买或商务跟进诉求。

若用户仅问「联系方式」：若语境是寻求销售、采购、合作对接，倾向 "yes"；若语境是售后维修、技术支持，倾向 "no"。
lead_capture.trigger_conditions_en:
Set purchase_intent to "yes" when the user clearly shows commercial intent, including:
1) Pricing: how much, quote, pricing, MSRP, budget, payment terms, discounts.
2) Purchase & channels: where to buy, how to order, pre-order, lead time, shipping, reseller/dealer, regional sales, official purchase link.
3) Business: procurement, tender/RFP, bulk order, partnership, distributor inquiry, sales contact, business WeChat/phone.
4) Demo & trials: schedule a demo, on-site demo, trial unit, PoC, showroom visit.

Set purchase_intent to "no" for pure technical Q&A (specs, how-to, charging, troubleshooting, warranty policy) unless buying/commercial intent is also present.

If the user only asks for "contact": lean "yes" for sales/partnership; lean "no" for service/repair/technical support.

catalog_items.trigger_scene: 用户询问户外巡检、安防巡逻、复杂地形作业、四足机器人在工业或园区场景的应用
catalog_items.recommendation_content_cn: FF Aegis Ultra 是一款 IP54 防护等级的四足机器人，支持最大 40° 爬坡和 35cm 垂直跳跃，配备 FPV 摄像头和扩展接口，可搭载自定义传感器与负载（最大 5kg），适合户外巡检、安防巡逻等复杂环境作业场景。
catalog_items.recommendation_content_en: FF Aegis Ultra is an IP54-rated quadruped robot capable of climbing slopes up to 40° and jumping 35 cm vertically. Equipped with an FPV camera and expansion interfaces, it supports custom sensor and payload integration (up to 5 kg) — ideal for outdoor inspection, security patrol, and operations in challenging environments.
